verdict: Ads have not launched; overdue milestones are the priority this week.
narrative: Paid advertising has not gone live — $0 was spent and zero paid leads were received across the full 28-day window, because five launch milestones originally due July 31 and August 1 remain incomplete. Google Business Profile, your only active traffic source, delivered 82 actions this period but came to a hard stop over the last four days, recording zero actions August 23–26 — that is being investigated now. Eight new opportunities entered the pipeline this period, but none have converted to booked consultations, so closing that gap is a parallel priority. The immediate focus is resolving the overdue milestones so paid search and Meta campaigns can go live, at which point you will have a second traffic source running alongside organic.
